svg.text: MODELS strip, twin of the ACTIVITY bar: one segment per run, in transcript order, width ∝ entries. Clicking a segment jumps to its start.
Inside the subagent session, the strip opens with the inbound baton: who delegated to this session (reverse link to the parent row).
Relay lane in a 14 px gutter: colour of the active model. Colours are per-session slots (1st model, 2nd model…), never per provider.
Hatched lane / segment = no recorded model. Visible, never guessed.
Knot on the lane where the model changes, with the new slug; drawn inside the first row of the new run (not a new list item).
Baton: left = who asked (stored source_model), right = who worked (linked child session). Dashed “unknown” pill when not available.
